more_info.overview: Potassium aluminium silicate is specified as natural mica, consisting mainly of muscovite. Its anti-caking role is to reduce the tendency of particles in a food powder to stick together. The specified material is natural mica, composed mainly of potassium aluminium silicate. It is mineral derived. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. The specification describes it as effectively insoluble in water.
more_info.origin: The specified material is natural mica, composed mainly of potassium aluminium silicate. It is mineral derived.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain dairy analogues, including beverage whiteners; vegetable oil pan spray.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
